history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration pilot practices for the consideration of material and recurring compliance issues identified by oversight bodies when assessing senior managers’ performance.
history.administration_response: The Administration has undertaken a pilot analysis of the Board’s findings and recommendations as they relate to specific peacekeeping missions, with a focus on recurring compliance issues, and has included the results in the senior managers’ performance assessment for the 2021/22 reporting period. A similar analysis of the Board’s findings and recommendations for regular budget entities is currently being conducted as part of the senior managers’ performance assessment for the 2022/23 reporting period, with the results expected to be presented to the Management Performance Board for their review and deliberation by December 2023.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration achieved progress in the analysis of recurring issues identified by oversight bodies, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
